email_body:
Hi Transform Formwork team,

I'm applying for the Designer / Draftsperson role advertised on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your advert asks for someone who updates drawings to reflect site conditions and works closely with the site team, which suits me because on site I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against the work to cut down on errors and rework. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid role, I have not yet drawn formwork, and I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Designer / Draftsperson
paragraphs: I am applying for the Designer / Draftsperson role at Transform Formwork advertised on SEEK. A site-based drafting role with a formwork, steel fixing and concreting contractor, working next to the people who build from the drawings, is the kind of role I have been aiming for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards and construction requirements, and learned how civil works move from concept to documentation.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them to cut down on errors and rework, and I coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I hold a current White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney. My drafting is from study rather than a paid drafting role and I have not yet worked on formwork drawings, which I am keen to learn from your team.
Thank you for considering my application. Some of my course drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
